infoPlist.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: Aetheris requires Bluetooth access to form an offline mesh network for disaster victims and emergency responders.
infoPlist.NSBluetoothPeripheralUsageDescription: Aetheris uses Bluetooth Peripheral mode to broadcast emergency SOS signals to nearby devices.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Aetheris requires location access to pinpoint exact GPS coordinates of victims during disaster extraction.
